description: Read (decode) a QR code from an image file: photo, screenshot or scan (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, AVIF, SVG). Uses jsQR like the website, trying several sizes and inverted (light-on-dark) codes. Returns the text plus what it is (Link, Wi-Fi, Contact, Email, SMS, Phone, Location, Event or Text) with parsed fields, and safety notes for links (http, hidden @ user part, punycode lookalikes, bare IPs, odd ports). Links are never opened. Reads one code per image. Web version (with camera): https://s3eidat.github.io/qr-scanner/

image.description: The image containing a QR code: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

name: qr_read
title: QR code reader
